entry.title: Have you noticed any changes in the way people communicate now we have chatbots? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
entry.summary: Compared with about a year ago, have you noticed any changes in how you're interacting with other people, or in how they're interacting with you? If so, what has changed? I think I'm noticing real changes in friends who are using chatbots a lot to replace some interactions that might otherwise have occurred with people, specifically for advice or emotional support.
